title: Positive bulk and brane kinetic zero-mode benchmark
assumptions: one physical time and a positive-definite compact internal two-space
massless minimal zero mode with natural boundary conditions unless explicitly varied
positive position-dependent bulk kinetic coefficient Z6(theta)
brane current coupling evaluated at theta_b
the baryogenesis source requirement epsilon_Theta is imported from the 0.4 transport benchmark

action_and_norm.bulk_kinetic: S_bulk=-1/2 integral d6x sqrt(-g6) Z6(theta) g^MN partial_M Theta partial_N Theta
action_and_norm.brane_kinetic: S_brane=-1/2 integral d4x sqrt(-gamma) Z_b gamma^munu partial_mu Theta partial_nu Theta
action_and_norm.zero_mode_norm: D0=integral dtheta dchi exp(2A) sqrt(g2) Z6 + Zb_hat exp(2A_b)

secured_results.positive_norm: Z6(theta)>0 and Zb_hat>=0 make the isolated scalar norm matrix positive
secured_results.constant_zero_mode: for mu6=0 and natural boundary conditions the exact zero mode remains coordinate-constant for arbitrary positive Z6(theta)
secured_results.local_profile_result: a local positive kinetic well or bump modifies the normalization density and excited modes but not the coordinate profile of the exact minimal zero mode
secured_results.enhancement_condition: large xi0 requires a small global weighted kinetic average Z_eff rather than geometric zero-mode localization

positive_brane_kinetic_example.interpretation: positive localized kinetic energy suppresses the brane coupling

global_suppression_example.interpretation: the numerical coupling gate is met only through an extreme canonical normalization hierarchy; this is not localization and has no release effect

quarantine.negative_brane_kinetic: negative Zb_hat may increase the normalized brane amplitude but can make the generalized norm matrix indefinite and generate a kinetic ghost
quarantine.rule: no result obtained from an indefinite or near-singular norm matrix may be used as a physical bridge

limitations: the background A(theta), cap data and Z6(theta) are benchmark inputs rather than solutions of a common parent action
metric, flux, radion and scalar perturbations are not mixed
the EFT cutoff after extreme canonical normalization is not calculated
loop corrections and nonlinear interactions are not included
the codimension-two brane is represented by a localized norm contribution in a Ritz benchmark
no evidence effect; K1-D and K1-E remain closed
